agentSetupDialog.agentsAiCodingAssistants: Agents are AI coding assistants that work through a software project's tasks for you. You queue a task, an agent writes the code in its own copy, and you review what it did. They work only on tasks you give them.
agentSetupDialog.eachAgentWorksOwn: Each agent works on its own copy of the project, so your folder stays as it is until you apply the work.
agentSetupDialog.nothingReachesFolderUntil: Nothing reaches your folder until you review the work and press Apply, and anything you apply can be undone from History.
agentSetupDialog.stopAllAiStatus: Stop all AI in the status bar stops every agent at once.
agentSetupDialog.canTurnAgentsNow_one: You can turn agents on now and fix this later.
agentSetupDialog.canTurnAgentsNow_other: You can turn agents on now and fix these later.
agentSetupDialog.agentsNeedModelGood: Agents need a model that is good at using tools: reading files, running commands and saving their work. Small models that run on this PC may struggle. Keys and addresses come from Settings › AI, and each project can choose its own model in its settings.
agentSetupDialog.eachProjectUp4: In each project, up to 4. Each run needs its own copy of the project.
agentSetupDialog.offAgentStartsOnly: Off: an agent starts only when you press Start this task in the queue. Each project can change this in its settings.
agentSetupDialog.agentsKeepTheirWork: Agents keep their work in Git. Install Git for Windows from git-scm.com, then press Check again.
agentSetupDialog.builtAgentNeedsModel: The built-in agent needs a model. Set up {{aiName}}, or choose another model in the next step.
agentSetupDialog.comesButMissingReinstall: It comes with {{brand}} but is missing. Reinstall {{brand}} to bring it back. Agents you connect yourself still work.

agentsSection.useAiAgentsSoftware: Use AI agents for software projects
agentsSection.agentsAiCodingAssistants: Agents are AI coding assistants that work through tasks in a project's folder for you. Each one works on its own copy of the project, and nothing reaches your folder until you review the changes and apply them. Anything you apply can be undone from History. You can stop every agent at once with Stop all AI in the status bar.
agentsSection.whileOffHidesEvery: While this is off, {{brand}} hides every agent control and doesn't listen for agent connections on this computer.
agentsSection.agentComesProjectCan: The agent that comes with {{brand}}. A project can choose its own model and how it runs in its settings.
agentsSection.agentsNeedModelGood: Agents need a model that is good at using tools. Small models that run on this PC may struggle.
agentsSection.eachProjectEachRun: In each project. Each run needs its own copy of the project.
agentsSection.agentApiDescription: Connected agents reach {{brand}} on this port, on this computer only (127.0.0.1), and only while agents are on. The automation API's port is in Settings › Connections.
agentsSection.agentApiPortHint: Changing it restarts the agent API. Connected agents must reconnect.
agentsSection.treatAgentStuckAfter: Treat an agent as stuck after
agentsSection.agentHasntReportedLong: An agent that hasn't reported for this long is flagged in its project's Agents view.
agentsSection.agentsWorkProjectsFolder: Agents work in a project's folder. Link a folder to a project in its settings to use agents there.
agentsSection.copiesAddressProjectId: Copies the address, project ID and token the automation API needs
agentsSection.workingWaitingReviewQueued: $t(common:count.agent, {"count": {{agentCount}} }) working, {{reviewSessions}} waiting for review, $t(common:count.run, {"count": {{runCount}} }) queued. Updated {{when}}.
agentsSection.firstReportAppearsWithin: The first report appears within a minute.
agentsSection.currentTokenStopsWorking: The current token stops working at once. Anything using it will need the new one.
agentsSection.stopsWorkingOnceAutomation: It stops working at once, and the automation API refuses calls for this project until you create a new one.

agentsTab.agentQueueIsntAvailable: The agent queue isn't available for this project yet.
agentsTab.queuedTasksRunAutomatically2_one: Queued tasks run automatically, up to {{count}} built-in agent at a time.
agentsTab.queuedTasksRunAutomatically2_other: Queued tasks run automatically, up to {{count}} built-in agents at a time.
agentsTab.queuedTasksWaitPress: Queued tasks wait for you to press Run. Turn this on to let {{brand}} run them automatically.
agentsTab.howManyBuiltAgents: How many built-in agents may run at once (up to 4, the number of agent workspaces a project has). {{running}} running now, {{used}}/{{maximum}} agent workspaces in use.
agentsTab.mostBuiltAgentsRunning: Most built-in agents running at once
agentsTab.historyKeptTaskGoes: Its history is kept, and the task stays in Ready. While agents are on, every task in Ready is queued, so it is queued again straight away. To keep it waiting, put it on hold instead.
agentsTab.queueTaskBeforeStart: Queue a task before you start an agent.
agentsTab.couldntReadAgentApi: Couldn't read the Agent API settings: {{error}}
agentsTab.agentApiOffTurn: The Agent API is off. Turn it on in Settings › Agents before you start a connected agent.
agentsTab.agentApiPortIsnt: The Agent API port isn't valid. Set a port from 1 to 65535 in Settings › Agents.
agentsTab.couldntStartAgentRun: Couldn't start the agent run. Try again.
agentsTab.openLiveTranscriptEvery: Open the live transcript: every message, tool call and command, as it happens.
agentsTab.legacyNeedsAttention: Earlier agent work needs a look
agentsTab.legacyNeedsAttentionBody: {{brand}} couldn't finish moving this project's earlier agent work to the new copies: {{problem}}. Nothing was lost; a backup was kept.

needsYouSection.nothingNeedsRightNow: Nothing to review right now. Agent questions and finished tasks show up here.
needsYouSection.runsWaitingReview2: Tasks ready for you to review
needsYouSection.finished: Finished: apply it to your project, send it back or discard it
needsYouSection.versionChangedNote: Your project folder is on {{folder}} now; this task started from {{task}}.

runningNowSection.noAgentRunningQueued: No agent is running. Queued tasks start from the queue below.
runningNowSection.versionSwitched: Your project folder has switched to a different version since this task started.

stopAgent.title: Stop "{{title}}"?
stopAgent.body: The agent stops where it stands. Its work is kept aside, so you can bring it back from History, and its task goes back to the queue.

agentReportModal.sentAgentFinishedTask: Sent {{when}} by the agent that finished this task.
agentReportModal.agentNamedNoFiles: The agent named no files. {{brand}} rebuilt this list from the agent workspace's changes, so it shows what changed, not the agent's account of what it did.
agentReportModal.builtAgentSentNo: The built-in agent sent no report, so this needs your review.
agentReportModal.agentsReportDoesntMatch: The agent's report doesn't match its changes, so this needs your review.
agentReportModal.agentsOwnReportNot: The agent's own report, not written by {{brand}}.
agentReportModal.reportDoesntMatchWhat: This report doesn't match what {{brand}} saw in the agent workspace.

executionQueueSection.completedTasksHiddenDefault: Accepted runs are hidden by default so the queue shows work you can still act on. Runs in review always show.
executionQueueSection.cancelEveryQueuedAgent: Cancel every queued agent run. Their tasks stay in Ready, so while agents are on they are queued again straight away.
executionQueueSection.queuedStartsOwnOnce: Queued. It starts on its own once the tasks it waits on are done; you don't need to do anything.
executionQueueSection.keptStepTask: Kept in step with its task
executionQueueSection.moveFrontQueue: Move {{taskTitle}} to the front of the queue
executionQueueSection.moveBackQueue: Move {{taskTitle}} to the back of the queue
executionQueueSection.startsConnectedAgentRun: Starts a connected agent run for this task.
executionQueueSection.openLiveTranscriptEvery: Open the live transcript: every message, tool call and command from this agent.
executionQueueSection.noAgentRunsMatch: No agent runs match your filters
executionQueueSection.queueReadyTaskBoard: Queue a Ready task from the Board, or add a one-off agent run below.
executionQueueSection.unplannedWorkOnlyCreate: For unplanned work only. Create and prioritise project work as tasks on the board instead.
executionQueueSection.theirHistoryKeptTheir: Their history is kept, and their tasks stay in Ready. While agents are on, every task in Ready is queued, so they are queued again straight away. To keep one waiting, put it on hold instead.
executionQueueSection.runsTaskBuiltAgent: Runs this task with the built-in agent, instead of a connected agent you paste a prompt into.
executionQueueSection.stopHandingSameAgent: Stop handing this on to the same agent
executionQueueSection.handSameAgent: Hand this on to the same agent
executionQueueSection.autoRunOn_one: Run queued tasks automatically: On (up to {{count}} at once)
executionQueueSection.autoRunOn_other: Run queued tasks automatically: On (up to {{count}} at once)
executionQueueSection.agentWorking: An agent is working on this task
executionQueueSection.completedRunsHidden_one: {{count}} accepted agent run is hidden; tick "Include accepted" to see it.
executionQueueSection.completedRunsHidden_other: {{count}} accepted agent runs are hidden; tick "Include accepted" to see them.
executionQueueSection.copyFailed: Couldn't make the agent's copy. It will try again.

liveTranscriptModal.couldntLoadTranscriptTry: Couldn't load the transcript. Try again.
liveTranscriptModal.ratePerMinute_comment: Tool calls in the last minute against the limit: “12 / 60 per minute”.

walkthrough.title: Walkthrough
walkthrough.notShown: These lines are not in the changes shown: the agent may have named lines it did not change.
walkthrough.notShownTruncated: These lines are not in the changes shown, which stop early because the change is large. Open the copy in the Code tab to read them.

sessionReviewModal.sendWorkBackReason: Send this work back with a reason, and say what should happen to the task next.
sessionReviewModal.watchWhatBuiltAgent: Watch what this built-in agent is doing, live
sessionReviewModal.opensAgentWorkspaceCode: Opens this agent workspace in the Code tab (labelled Low integrity on Windows, so it can't write outside it)
sessionReviewModal.showingOnlyStartChanges: Showing only the start of the changes; the rest is too long to preview.
sessionReviewModal.attachedRevision_comment: “r3” is revision 3 of a Library item.

taskAgentRunSection.onceQueueSameAgent: Once you queue it, the same agent may carry on with the next task.
taskAgentRunSection.whatAgentSaidDid: What the agent said it did for this task.
taskAgentRunSection.copiesTaskConnectionDetails: Copies the task and the connection details as one instruction to paste into your agent.
taskAgentRunSection.agentHasntChangedAnything: The agent hasn't changed anything yet.
taskAgentRunSection.previewShowsFirst200: The preview shows the first 200 KB of changes.
taskAgentRunSection.sendWorkBackReason: Send this work back with a reason, and say what should happen to the task next.
taskAgentRunSection.lookOverChangesThen: Look over the changes, then accept or discard them.
taskAgentRunSection.previewRefreshesWhileAgent: This preview refreshes while the agent works.
taskAgentRunSection.messageAgentHint: Changed your mind about this task while it runs? Tell the agent.

rejectWorkForm.whyBeingRejected: Why are you sending it back?
rejectWorkForm.sayWhatWrongWork: Say what is wrong with the work. The agent is given exactly this text.
rejectWorkForm.thenWhatHappensTask: Then what happens to the task?
rejectWorkForm.reasonRequiredWholePoint: A reason is required: it is what the agent works from next.
rejectWorkForm.discardsChangesRecordsReason: Records your reason on the task and does what you chose.

retry.label: Back in the queue
retry.hint: The agent carries on in the same copy, with your reason in the task details.

rework.label: Back to planning
rework.hint: Sets the work aside and cancels the run, so you can revise the task before you queue it again.

hold.label: Hold it
hold.hint: Stays queued but on hold: it shows as Blocked and no agent takes it.

automationPromptCard.describeWhatWantExternal: Describe what you want an external AI to do, then generate a ready-to-paste prompt that includes the connection details and API instructions it needs.
automationPromptCard.generateAutomationTokenProject: Create an automation token for this project first, in Settings › Connections.
automationPromptCard.eGCreateNew: e.g. Create a new task that checks the weather

guidance.title: Send guidance: {{title}}
guidance.descriptionBuiltIn: The agent gets your message in its session straight away, labelled as from you, and carries on with it in mind.
guidance.descriptionConnected: The agent gets your message, labelled as from you, the next time it reads its session.
guidance.hint: Markdown. The agent takes it as your word on this task; it cannot widen what the agent may do. Up to {{max}} characters.
guidance.sentWaiting: Guidance sent. The agent gets it when it next reads its session.

runModel.externalUsesOwn: For the built-in agent. A connected agent uses the model set in that tool.
runModel.setInConnectedAgent: Model: set in the connected agent
runModel.dialogDescription: The built-in agent runs this task with the model you choose. It can change while the task waits in the queue, not once the run starts.
runModel.chooseModelHint: Which model and effort the built-in agent uses for this task
runModel.queueWithModelHint: Choose the built-in agent's model and effort for this run
runModel.couldntChangeModel: Couldn't change the model for this run. Try again.
runModel.runAgainWithHint: Discard this run's changes and queue the task again, with another model if you like

usagePrices.description: Prices per million tokens, in your own currency, for the run history’s costs. Without a price for a model, no cost is shown for its runs: {{brand}} never guesses one.
usagePrices.modelHint: The model id as the run history shows it, for example claude-sonnet-5-5.

runHistory.noPrices: Set prices in Settings › Agents › Usage to see costs
runHistory.costIncomplete: cost leaves out models without a price
runHistory.noRunsYet: Every agent run will show here once it ends.
runHistory.noLimits: No token limits for the built-in agent. Set them in Project settings › Agents.
runHistory.limitReached: Limit reached: no new built-in runs start.

taskReview.applyHint: Add this work to your project folder as one entry in History. Your own edits are saved first, so you can undo it.
taskReview.closeNothingChangedHint: The agent changed nothing, so there is nothing to apply.
taskReview.discardBody: The task goes back to the queue. Its work is kept aside, so you can bring it back from History until the time set in Settings › Data runs out.
taskReview.versionChangedTitle: Your project folder is on a different version
taskReview.versionChangedBody: This task started from {{task}}, and your project folder is on {{folder}} now. Apply it to the current version, or wait until the folder is back on {{task}}.
taskReview.appliedBody: It is one entry in History, where you can undo it.
taskReview.sentBackBody: Your project changed while it worked, and the changes overlap. The agent brings its work up to date, and you review it again.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.askHint: A second run can review this work before you decide. It uses a copy of its own, changes nothing, and counts towards usage limits.
reviewer.beingReviewed: Being reviewed. You can read the changes and decide meanwhile.
reviewer.overdue: The reviewer has not finished after 30 minutes. You can decide without it.
reviewer.notReported: The reviewer did not finish its review.
reviewer.sendBackAsMineLabel: Send back the finding on {{where}} as my comment
reviewer.sendBackAsMineGeneralLabel: Add the finding on {{where}} to my Send back reason
reviewer.applyBody_one: {{count}} must-fix finding is open. Apply anyway?
reviewer.applyBody_other: {{count}} must-fix findings are open. Apply anyway?

lineComments.title: Comments
lineComments.help: Click a line number to comment on that line, and Shift+click another to take in a range. With the keyboard: Tab to a line number, move with the Up and Down arrows, hold Shift with the arrows to take in more lines, and press Enter to write a comment.
lineComments.label: Comment on {{lines}}
lineComments.hint: Plain text, up to 2,000 characters. The agent gets it with the code it is about when you send the work back.
lineComments.none: No comments yet. Click a line number in the changes to add one.
lineComments.tooMany: You can leave at most {{count}} comments.
lineComments.saveFailed: Your comments could not be kept: {{message}}
lineComments.reasonOptional: Optional with line comments: if you leave it empty, the agent is told to see the line comments.
lineComments.applyBody_one: {{count}} comment will not be sent. Apply anyway?
lineComments.applyBody_other: {{count}} comments will not be sent. Apply anyway?
lineComments.lastReviewHint: What you asked for when you last sent this task back, on the attempt before this one. Check each was dealt with.

commentAnswers.hint: What you asked for when you last sent this task back, with the agent's answer to each. An answer is the agent's word: check it in the changes.
commentAnswers.showLabel: Show where the agent dealt with {{where}}
commentAnswers.commentAgainGone: These lines are not in the new changes. Comment on the lines where the code is now.

planFirst.agentsOwnText: This is the agent's own text, shown as it was sent.
planFirst.runWaits: The run waits until you decide, with no time limit. Its copy stays in use meanwhile.
planFirst.changedWhileWaiting_one: The agent has already changed {{count}} file before you approved its plan.
planFirst.changedWhileWaiting_other: The agent has already changed {{count}} files before you approved its plan.
planFirst.changedBeforeApproval_one: {{count}} file changed before the plan was approved:
planFirst.changedBeforeApproval_other: {{count}} files changed before the plan was approved:
planFirst.changesNoteHint: The agent reads this, revises the plan and sends it again.
planFirst.confirmCancelBody: The agent stops. Anything it did is kept aside as Stop keeps it, and the task goes back to the queue.
planFirst.noPlan: This run has not sent a plan.
planFirst.panelRow: Version {{version}} · the run waits until you decide
planFirst.planFirstHint: The agent sends a plan and waits for your approval before it changes anything.
planFirst.planFirstLocked: Set this before the task is queued.
planFirst.changedNotInPlan: Changed but not in the plan
planFirst.inPlanNotChanged: In the plan but not changed
planFirst.filesMatch: Every changed file was in the plan, and every planned file changed.

tryIt.title: Try it
tryIt.noCommandReason: Set a try command in Project settings › Agents to run this task's work before you apply it.
tryIt.runsCommand: Runs {{command}} in this task's copy, so you can see the change working. Nothing is applied.
tryIt.warningBody: Try it runs {{command}} on the agent's code, with your rights, as running it yourself would. Only try work you are willing to run.
tryIt.closeBody: Try it is still running. Closing Review changes stops it.

lessons.offerBody: Is this something every agent on the project should know?
lessons.dialogDescription: Save a lesson every later agent on this project reads with the conventions. Nothing is saved until you save it.
lessons.lessonHint: Write it as a rule for any task, such as “Use formatDate from src/shared/format.ts for dates, never a new helper.”
lessons.savedBody: Later agents on this project read it with the conventions.
lessons.groupDescription: Rules you saved when sending work back. Agents read the ones that are on after the conventions, each with its date.
lessons.none: No lessons yet. After sending work back, choose Remember this for next time.

playbooks.saveAsHint: A task template for agents, with a model, plan first and extra instructions
playbooks.saveDescription: A playbook is a task template for agents. Run playbook makes this task again and queues it for agents in one step, with what you choose here.
playbooks.savedBody: Run it from the command palette, the Agents tab or the project's More menu.
playbooks.planFirstHint: Whether the agent sends a plan and waits for you before it changes anything.
playbooks.instructionsHint: Your words about this task, in Markdown, up to {{max}} characters. They are added to the queued task's details under "Playbook instructions".
playbooks.runHint: Make a task from a playbook and queue it for agents
playbooks.runDescription: {{brand}} makes the task from the playbook and queues it for agents in one step.
playbooks.taskTitleHint: Leave it as it is, or change it for this run.
playbooks.noneHint: Open a task and choose Save as playbook… from its menu, or make a task template a playbook in Settings › Projects › Task templates.
playbooks.agentsOff: Agents are off. Turn on agents in Settings to run a playbook.
playbooks.noFolder: This project has no linked folder, so there is nothing for an agent to work in. Link a folder in the project's settings to run a playbook.
playbooks.modelNotOffered: {{model}} is no longer offered, so this run uses the project's default model.
playbooks.scheduled_comment: On a queued task or run that a repeating task queued for agents on its start date (N9.7).

agentPrompt.title: Agent prompt
agentPrompt.sessionHint: The prompt the agent working on this task was given.
agentPrompt.automationHint: Not queued: copies the task with the automation API's connection details, to paste into your agent. Nothing is queued.
agentPrompt.tokenMadeOnCopy: (its own token, made when you copy)
agentPrompt.automationTokenMissing: (turn on the automation API and make its token in Settings › Connections first)
